correctness.rationale: Normalize unit-modulus 3x3 determinant: vanishing forces a proportional row/column pair by conjugate identity. In coprime CRT characters, row proportionality forces its nonzero difference in exactly one prime component and all opposing column differences pure in its complementary component. Four events are exhaustive; the only two overlap types are opposite-purity rank-one pairs. Inclusion-exclusion gives R1=2XY, R2=2(XB+YA-2XY) with X=p*C(q,3),Y=q*C(p,3),A=C(pq,3)-q^3*C(p,3),B=C(pq,3)-p^3*C(q,3). Independent exact-integer recalculation reproduced (0,1600,12800) for (2,5), (300,13800,192925) for (3,5), (1470,91728,1675702) for (3,7), and (24500,1146600,41665925) for (5,7).
